items.title: Leslie Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Jim Cullum; the interviewer mentions him as a fact ('Jim Cullum made a big hit last year') to prompt a question about the concert lineup.

ctx.x: Talking to Vince last night, I almost felt like saying how come you’re not playing at this thing, you know? I mean it would have been, when I looked at the line-up of the concerts, © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-
there’s a lot of great stuff here but it would have been nice to have — now Jim Cullum made a big hit last year, okay? So why isn’t there something like that again?
